title: 40 Blue Edge Tiles, 80 White: How Long Is the Floor? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
A floor has a ring of blue tiles around the edge and white tiles inside. Can two counts tell us its shape?
We make a list of floors, then use the edge to get length plus width. Then try a new floor yourself!
